title: Load vault context files
description: This helper combines Markdown files from agent-context into one system-prompt preamble.

steps.description: The script names its vault and agent-context folder with pathlib paths.
load_context finds Markdown files in sorted order. For each file, it adds a heading from the filename and then the file contents.

steps.question: In what order does the helper add context files?
steps.answer: It uses sorted on the matching Markdown paths, so it adds them in sorted filename order.

steps.description: The function joins the collected parts. If an exception occurs, it prints the error and returns an empty string.
When the file runs as a program, it prints the combined context string.
